template.name: Warm Community
template.feeling: A neighborhood porch or a family table: soft colors, rounded shapes, playful details, plain warm words.
template.preview_badge: Every page carries a Template preview strip at the top and a Template preview tag in the footer.

contrast_checks.method: WCAG 2.x relative luminance formula, run with a Node script
contrast_checks.rechecked: 2026-11-19, critic pass: every pair recomputed with the WCAG 2.x formula in Node; all body text pairs are 4.5 to 1 or better. On phones the statement text sits on solid Dusk (12.05).
contrast_checks.lowest_body_text_pair: Cocoa Soft on Sunflower 4.68, used only for small notes; all body copy on Sunflower is Cocoa at 9.23.

display.use: Headlines, card titles, quotes, big service times. Tight tracking (minus 1 to 2.5 percent) at large sizes.

body.use: Body 17 px at 1.65 line height, buttons and labels in 800, lining figures.

accent.use: Handwritten notes, snapshot captions and the pastors signature. Two or three times a page.

shapes.signature_corner: One swoopy corner per photo frame (120px on the pastors and newsletter photos)
shapes.rules: No thin hard rules. Sections use a 2px soft rule topped by a hand-drawn wave mark; the brand board uses a 2px dashed divider.
accents: Wave rule on next-step columns and numbered rows
Scalloped Sunflower porch awning over one photo band per page
Soft blobs behind photos (one or two per page)
White tilted sticker labels (two per page at most)
Caveat hand note with a drawn arrow
Sunflower highlighter stroke behind one phrase
Picnic gingham for social and print
shapes.buttons: Sunflower pill with Cocoa text and a soft inner bottom edge for the one primary action; Cocoa outline pills for the rest; Porch outline pills on Dusk.

motion.character: Neighborly bounce: gentle spring overshoot, hand-drawn lines that draw themselves, nothing glows.
system: Scroll reveal: sections rise 22px with a spring. JS adds reveal-init only after the observer is ready and only below the fold; reveal-in shows them. Content is visible at rest.
Next-step columns and cards rise one by one (120 ms stagger); a wave line draws across each column then settles to a short mark.
Hover: a Porch White panel wipes up behind each column; cards lift 8px and tilt under a degree; arrows slide.
Primary buttons: a sheen sweeps once when they first scroll into view and a soft light follows the cursor, inside the pill only.
Hero: the photo drifts slowly (28 s Ken Burns); the changing word leaves before the next arrives, never overlapping; the underline under chair draws in on load.
Mission highlighter draws behind porch light on scroll; the announcement play button pulses gently; the photo strip scrolls slowly with a Pause button.
prefers-reduced-motion: every animation and transition stops, reveals are visible, the strip becomes a swipeable row and the word stays still.

photo_treatment.grade: Warm whites, a touch of extra yellow, natural skin. Daylight, golden hour, lamps and string lights.
photo_treatment.frames: Rounded 28 to 34px frames, one swoopy corner on feature photos, white snapshot borders with Caveat captions in the photo strip.
photo_treatment.subjects: Adults mid-conversation, shared tables, coffee, porches and yards. Kids only in groups or from behind.
photo_treatment.avoid: Concert haze as a lead image, posed rows, single-child close-ups, cold or black and white grades, logos or other church names.

logo.concept: An open door in the afternoon sun: a Sunflower circle holding a Cocoa arched doorway on a porch step, with one new Leaf sprouting at the top right. The doorway says come on in; the sun is the porch light; the leaf is growth.
logo.wordmark: goldenrod in Fredoka 600 lowercase, with COMMONS CHURCH in Nunito Sans 800 caps tracked 24 percent beneath it.
lockups: Primary horizontal (mark left, two-line wordmark right)
Small mark alone for avatars, favicon and chat (minimum 20px; drop the leaf below that)

reversals.on_dusk: Door takes Dusk #1F2D4D, wordmark Porch White
reversals.on_sunflower: Sun turns Porch White, door stays Cocoa

logo.clear_space: One door height on every side
logo.build: Inline SVG symbol with CSS custom properties (--sun, --door) so every reversal uses the same drawing
